openapi: 3.1.1
info:
  title: Bank Test Support API
  version: 0.1.0
  description: |
    Test Support API for fixture management, page facts, assertions, and business date control.
    Only available under local/test profiles. Protected by TEST_SUPPORT authority.
    MUST NOT: be enabled in production, return secrets, write to Fineract DB, or bypass state machines.
servers:
  - url: /internal/test-support/v1
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
paths:
  /fixtures:seed:
    post:
      operationId: seedFixtures
      summary: Seed baseline test fixtures
      responses:
        '200': { description: Fixtures seeded }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
  /fixtures:reset:
    post:
      operationId: resetFixtures
      summary: Reset all test data to baseline
      responses:
        '200': { description: Fixtures reset }
  /fixtures/{logicalRef}:
    parameters:
      - name: logicalRef
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string }
    get:
      operationId: getFixture
      summary: Get fixture by logical reference (e.g., customer.alice)
      responses:
        '200': { description: Fixture detail with runtime IDs }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
  /pages:
    get:
      operationId: listPages
      summary: List all registered pages with stable locators
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Page catalog
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
  /assertions/payments/{paymentId}:
    parameters:
      - name: paymentId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string }
    get:
      operationId: assertPayment
      summary: Get payment assertion data (status, history, idempotency, core tran
saction, outbox, audit)
      responses:
        '200': { description: Payment assertion data }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
  /assertions/ledger/{correlationId}:
    parameters:
      - name: correlationId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string }
    get:
      operationId: assertLedger
      summary: Get ledger assertion data (debit/credit balance, journal entries)
      responses:
        '200': { description: Ledger assertion data }
  /assertions/reconciliation/{correlationId}:
    parameters:
      - name: correlationId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema: { type: string }
    get:
      operationId: assertReconciliation
      summary: Get reconciliation assertion data
      responses:
        '200': { description: Reconciliation assertion data }
  /business-date:advance:
    post:
      operationId: advanceBusinessDate
      summary: Advance business date by one day
      responses:
        '200': { description: Business date advanced }
        '409': { $ref: '#/components/responses/Problem' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth: { type: http, scheme: bearer, bearerFormat: JWT }
  responses:
    Problem:
      description: RFC 9457 problem details
      content:
        application/problem+json:
          schema:
            type: object
            required: [type, title, status, code]
            properties:
              type: { type: string }
              title: { type: string }
              status: { type: integer }
              code: { type: string }
              detail: { type: string }
